claims.exact_statement: For Theta_X(f)=sum_{x in X} q(Inf_x(f))+sum_{i notin X}q(E_X^f({i})), (i) Phi(fg)<=Theta_X(f)+Theta_X(g) for Boolean factors sharing X and having disjoint private variables; (ii) revealing x in X gives E Theta_{X-{x}}(f|x)<=Theta_X(f)-q(Inf_x(f)); and (iii) arbitrary signed block openings on a physical restriction tree telescope exactly to Phi(root) minus the terminal Theta reserve. If Delta_x U<=K Inf_x+lambda(R-O) along a complete adapted tree, then U<=(K+2lambda/ln2)I and H<=(2+2K+4lambda/ln2)I.
hypotheses: shared-product factors have disjoint private variables
proof_dependencies: U-universal Theorem G and restriction telescopes
